chunks: And it has been narrated from Sulaymān ibn Jaʿfar al-Jaʿfarī that he said:
I saw al-Riḍā عليه السلام praying in a khazz cloak.

key_terms.خَزٍّ: khazz, a type of fine cloth
key_terms.سُلَيْمَانَ: Sulaymān, the named transmitter of the report

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat in a jubbah made of khazz?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Sulaymān ibn Jaʿfar al-Jaʿfarī saw al-Riḍā عليه السلام performing salat in a jubbah made of khazz. In the chapter context, it serves as evidence regarding the permissibility of praying in such a garment.
